title: Naturality of the normalized open realization on good systems
statement: For system operations o, AmbientModels a, and a quasi-compact open immersion j:U→V, let M,N be good systems whose open extensions are good. For every system morphism s:M→N, L_V(J_j(s)) followed by the open realization at N equals the open realization at M followed by integral open extension of L_U(s). This concerns one primitive open extension and no expression trees, basic generators, finite coefficient projections or compact-support operations.

source.place: Coefficient comparisons and inherited equations, expanded strict-system realization argument.

proof.text: By normalized reconstruction the actual counits at M and N are invertible. Their open images and total limits are invertible as well. Goodness of J_j(N) makes the reconstruction unit at L_V(J_j(N)) invertible. Naturality of that unit along the specified open realization isomorphism makes its component at integral j_!(L_U N) invertible.

Precompose the proposed square by L_V(J_j(epsilon_M)) and postcompose by the unit at integral j_!(L_U N). Counit naturality moves the source factor through J_j(s). Unit naturality moves the target factor through integral j_!(L_U(s)). The two openNormalization equations then turn both sides into the naturality equation of openReduction, whiskered by total limit. Cancel the two invertible factors. This uses whole-system naturality and works unchanged for zero systems and empty opens.

lean.statement:
theorem integralOpenRealizationNaturality
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hq : QuasiCompact j)
    (M N : System l E U) (hM : Good l E U M) (hN : Good l E U N)
    (hJM : Good l E V ((Operations.shriek l E o j).obj M))
    (hJN : Good l E V ((Operations.shriek l E o j).obj N)) (s : M ⟶ N) :
    (coefficientSequenceLimit l E V).map ((Operations.shriek l E o j).map s) ≫
      (a.openRealization j hq N hN hJN).hom =
    (a.openRealization j hq M hM hJM).hom ≫
      (ringedOpen l E j).map ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E U).map s)
